reviews.title: Better than a counter top unit
reviews.body: I should start off by saying the item works great , and it is the only one I found that had a digital display of the vacuum level . That being said there are 2 cons ;1.they advertise 24/7 customer support , but there is no phone  # for customer support I emailed customer support with a question and tried to contact them through comments on their YouTube , channel , still no response from either after a week . So I am not really too convinced of their 24/7 customer support .2 . The question I had was in relation to getting liquid in the unit. Almost all of the other similar handheld units I looked at , have a small transparent cup at the bottom of the unit that acts as a see through liquid trap . It only holds less than a tablespoon of water , but still it gives you a little warning and protection from sucking liquid into the unit . There is no such feature on the natupo. Instead the instructions simply give you a warning not to suck any liquid into the unit . To be fair there is still about 1/2" of space between the bottom of the suction ring and the point where liquid would actually enter the unit , but it would be nice if there were an actual liquid trap like some of the other units . It's not a huge deal if you are careful and there are a couple of ways to solve it . One would be to pre freeze what you are vacuuming . Another way you could prevent it if you were vacuuming fish meat or berries , is to put a couple of folded paper towels in the bag with the product so there is no free flowing liquids . That doesn't mean you can't vacuum sea things like soup or juice , just don't overfill the bag , only put enough in so you can use the ziplock feature of the bags to seal in enough air so you can lay it flat without the liquid touching the vacuum port , pre freeze till there is no actual liquid then vacuum seal , works great . It should be noted that the bags are of significantly higher quality than the roll bags that come with most counter top units . I also found the bags easier to use than the roll bags ,since the actual sealing of the bag is handled by a heavy duty deluxe zip lock , you only have to deal with the pumping of the bag , so there is no heat sealing of the bag like with the tool bags , plus the bags are thicker than the roll bags and seem to be made of slightly better material .  Replacement bags are expensive but less so when you consider they are washable/reusable .All in all , I would much rather have one of these units than a corded counter top unit . Takes up way less space , vacuums just as well , no heat sealing of the bags to worry about , and no cord to deal with . Why spend $100+ when you can get one that's easier to use and works just as well for $35 . Would have given 5 stars if it weren't for lack of customer service response.

    Small & convenient device. Easy & quick charging. I haven't tested in the microwave but the suction works well. Seals completely in about 1m30s. I like the auto shut off feature & the digital screen. The bag sizes are reasonable, put them side by side a regular 1gal storage bag for comparison. Leak free once sealed.Would have been great if the suction pump was a little higher towards the corner this way i have a little more storage but it is not a deal breaker.Not very great if u seal a lot of fresh items as the manual says to avoid liquids. U will have to drain the item as much as possible before sealing.Overall, for the price and convenience i recommend.

reviews.title: Highly impressive!
reviews.body: I must say, I am over the moon with this product! I’ve saved so much money on food already! It works exactly as advertised! My food is staying fresher longer in the refrigerator and never has that “left over” taste or smell! This is one of the best products I’ve purchased in a very long time that actually works perfectly! It’s easy to use! I absolutely love it!

reviews.title: Effective Vacuum Sealer
reviews.body: A great product for the price. Plenty of suction power to fully seal bags. Long lasting on one charge. Great for frozen foods. Like the reusable bags. So easy to use.

reviews.title: This Sealer is the Best!
reviews.body: Works great! It is a reasonable price and I especially appreciate the compact size. Don't forget to position the food in the bag a little space away from the round contact spot that you place the sealer over. This will engage the vacuuming quicker and avoid getting moisture into the vacuum pump. We've used other vacuum sealers and this one is the best!

reviews.title: Excellent product.
reviews.body: Excellent product. I have been absolutely delighted with this little vacuum sealer. I actually stopped using my large countertop sealer, and now use this exclusively. Holds a great charge, extremely quiet, and just overall a great product.. Also came with many vacuum bags, which was a delight and bonus. Would highly recommend this unit for someone looking for a easy to use quiet efficient vacuum sealer. A++

reviews.title: Compact and efficient space-saving device.
reviews.body: Perfect for quick packing and sealing of everyday dishes. Fridgespace-saving and also good for the freezer. It has even worked with multiple ziplock baggies inside the vacuum sealer bag provided with the device. I would recommend it for its versatility and compact size.
